text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's New Year's, and we decide to<n>visit a shrine to
make a wish for<n>success in Biwa Hayahide's
coming<n>senior races.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe it's already a new<n>year. Time sure
does fly.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
By the way, did you watch the Asahi<n>Hai F.S. last
month?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide participated in that G1<n>before. It's
one of the races that<n>determines the junior year
champion.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I heard Narita Brian took first in it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Time really does go by quickly. She's<n>a classic
racer already.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It might even be as soon as thisyear...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide takes a deep breath<n>and lets it out
as if she's steeling<n>herself for something. Then,
she turns<n>to me again.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The battle between Brian and me<n>might be as soon
as this year.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We need to start gathering data on<n>Brian right
away. I doubt she'll stop<n>with the Classic Triple
Crown tour.
choice_data_list: We need to be ready to beat her.
We need to be ready to beat her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Exactly.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the line's moving. We'd better<n>start thinking
about what we want to<n>pray for.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What will you ask for this year,<n>Trainer?
choice_data_list: For us to improve your abilities so you can win.
For us to polish up your technique.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You're praying for my sake and not<n>your own? You
really prioritize us<n>racers over yourself too much.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Why don't we drink some amazakeafter we're done praying? We can doa little New Year's toast to both ourhealth.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, I enjoy the start of the new<n>year with Biwa
Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you're right. That's something<n>we need to
work on together.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let's do some training when we get<n>back, so we
can make that wish of<n>yours come true.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, Biwa Hayahide and I get<n>started training
from the very first day<n>of the new year.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm, my technique? I feel like you<n>already help me
enough with my<n>running skills...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But I love that you never get<n>complacent. I'll take a
leaf out of your<n>book and pray for the same, then.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, I spend a nice start to the<n>new year with
Biwa Hayahide.
